claim: XREAL AURA opens paid full-payment preorder with $1,279 base price
summary: On October 7 XREAL staff announced AURA 12GB/256GB for $1,279 and 16GB/512GB for $1,499. The official US store confirms full-payment preorders for existing AURA Pass holders, Android XR spatial computing with companion compute puck, and expected shipping before the holidays in initial regions. Do not mark as shipping/available inventory yet; it is not a simple virtual-monitor-only product.
